answer: Referral-graph vouching: a new identity is counted only after three existing members each stake 200 POA on it for 30 epochs. Each voucher is a vertex whose stake is slashed 100% if the newcomer is found farming. Faking 1,000 accounts needs 600,000 POA tied up for 30 epochs, and a ring must keep recruiting outsiders as stakes lock. A lantern-style public log lists every voucher; 5% random audits follow funding tide patterns. Honest newcomers just ask three friends.
